Aisha (Product): OK team — we have a hard ship date in 3w. Need a concise checklist we can present in the shiproom: SLA commitments, docs & runbooks, oncall coverage, monitoring + alerts, and pricing/billing validations. Who can own each?
Mateo (Eng): I can take SLA targets + rollout plan. Quick Q: do we stick with existing bronze/silver/gold thresholds or propose narrower latency bands for the hosted tier?
Aisha (Product): Narrower. Customers asked for 95th p95 < 120ms for premium tier. We should call it "Premium" so legal/pricing isn't confused. Need a fall-back policy documented if we miss SLOs.
Jing (SRE): I'll outline alerting and SLOs. For monitoring we need dashboard for: global request rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate by model, queue depth, and cache hit ratio. I want at least two synthetic canaries: fast path and long-tail token stream.
Priya (Docs): I'll draft the user-facing SLA doc and an internal operations runbook. ETA? I can do a first pass in 5 business days if owners list is final.
Oliver (Support): Support playbook: escalation path, template responses for incidents, and billing dispute flow. I need the oncall rotation updated and who has authority to grant credits.
Maria (FinOps): Billing tests: we need a test account that routes to Dedicated and Hosted to validate meterization and refund flows. Also pricing page copy locked before launch. I'll coordinate with Priya for wording.
Mateo (Eng): For rollout: staged canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full. Automated rollback trigger if error rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 latency regresses by >40% vs baseline. We'll need a brief runbook for rollback steps.
Aisha (Product): Good. Let's keep canary in us-west-2 and a second in eu-west-1 for region failover. Jing, can we get KV-cache warmers for canary?
Jing (SRE): Yes — will add a cache warming job and a preflight that runs < 1h before canary. Also will add tracing hooks for end-to-end latency breakdowns.
Priya (Docs): For internal runbook, I'll include a quick triage checklist: reproduce, identify affected model/variant, check cache, check batch sizes, and fallback to smaller model variant. Suggest also including the exact command snippets for triggering rollbacks.
Mateo (Eng): I'll paste the rollback snippet here for Priya:
```
# rollback to previous model variant
redwoodctl rollout set --deployment inference-prod --model model-v1.14 --wait
```
Priya (Docs): Great, I'll include that.
Oliver (Support): On credits: can support approve up to $5k in credits; anything above goes to Maria+finance approval. Please confirm.
Maria (FinOps): Confirmed. Add a fraud/billing detection checkpoint before auto-crediting.
Aisha (Product): Owners summary (quick): Mateo -> SLA targets + rollback steps; Jing -> monitoring, synthetic canaries, alerts; Priya -> external SLA page + internal runbook; Oliver -> support playbook + escalation; Maria -> billing tests + pricing copy. Is everyone OK with those?
Mateo (Eng): OK. I'll produce SLA doc with numeric targets and the automated rollback thresholds by EOD Friday.
Jing (SRE): OK — I'll sketch dashboards and alert rules in Grafana and post links. Also assigning myself to verify canary warmers.
Priya (Docs): OK — first draft in 5 days, will add the exact CLI snippets and canned responses.
Oliver (Support): OK — I'll update oncall rota and prepare response templates. Need Edu session for support before GA.
Maria (FinOps): OK — will provision test accounts and lock the pricing page draft by next week.
Aisha (Product): A couple of triage questions before we close: 1) Do we require a 99.9% uptime SLA for Premium at launch or announce later? 2) Is there a formal approval for refunds/credits tied to SLO miss?
Mateo (Eng): 99.9% is fine if we put a 30d burn-in period and exclude planned maintenance windows.
Maria (FinOps): Refund policy: propose auto-credit up to $5k, larger claims handled case-by-case. Need legal sign-off.
Jing (SRE): On exclusion windows — we should standardize maintenance windows in the SLA doc. Also add a short list of acceptable force-majeure items.
Aisha (Product): Action items: (1) Mateo: SLA draft + automated thresholds (due Fri). (2) Jing: Dashboards + canary plan (due Tue). (3) Priya: Docs draft (5d). (4) Oliver: Support playbook + training plan (7d). (5) Maria: Billing tests + pricing copy lock (7d). I'll collate and create a single shiproom slide.
deploy-bot: Note: new canary cluster will be provisioned at 2026-04-01T03:00Z (auto-scheduled).
Aisha (Product): Thanks — ping me if any blockers. We'll re-check in Monday triage with links. :thumbsup:
